title: Define model profile pack schema and local/stub/remote optionality
purpose: Define how AgentOS manages model routing profiles as artifacts without making remote models mandatory or leaking secrets.
scope: Represent local, stub and optional remote provider modes.
Bind model usage to allowed runtime roles such as plan, classify, summarize and sanitize.
acceptance_criteria: Remote provider is optional and policy-gated.
Model profile pack cannot contain raw credentials.
Profile activation does not bypass ModelBroker.
failure_modes: Remote model becomes required for boot or replay.
Pack lets workflow call provider directly instead of ModelBroker.
